thread:
maria_cs: @devon PlayWell asked to onboard a custom model `playwell-gpt-v1` for symptom triage. They flagged strict safety constraints (medical advice, PHI). Renewal in ~30 days; they say go-live timeline will affect renewal. Can we prioritize? :rotating_light:
devon_onboard: On it. @ken_ml can you take model/ops? I’ll own customer comms and enablement scheduling.
ken_ml: Need model artifacts (weights + tokenizer), example prompts, and a short spec of allowed/disallowed behaviors. Is quantized float16 OK?
maria_cs: Customer said quantized is fine. Training data contains de-identified notes but there’s residual PHI risk. They want KMS + audit logs + an explicit refusal policy for out-of-scope medical advice.
sara_risk: High level constraints: 1) automatic PHI detection + redaction before serving 2) refusal style must be consistent (give safe alternatives) 3) hallucination tolerance low — want measurable safety targets. We should run adversarial safety evals.
ken_ml: Proposed eval config (quick):
```json
{
  "eval_sets": ["playwell-safety-v1", "clinical-regression-v2"],
  "metrics": {"hallucination_rate": "<0.01", "incorrect_critical_advice": "<0.005"},
  "batch_size": 16,
  "deadline_hours": 48
}
```
devon_onboard: Timeline estimate: start today -> safety eval 48h -> mitigation/patching 24h -> private deploy 24h. Total ~4 business days if infra is free. Can we get expedited infra?
sam_account: Heads up — renewal team flagged PlayWell as at-risk if not live within 2 weeks. If we can commit to the 4–5 day timeline I can negotiate a provisional extension; otherwise risk of pause.
onboard-bot: Checklist created: 1) model artifacts upload 2) safety eval run 3) implement PHI redaction + refusal templates 4) private deploy + KMS 5) enable audit logs + monitoring 6) customer enablement session scheduled.
maria_cs: Action items: @ken_ml upload the eval results here, @devon schedule a short enablement call and request high-risk prompt examples from PlayWell, @sara_risk draft refusal copy and monitoring hooks, @sam_account confirm provisional extension by EOD. I’ll update the customer with our ETA.
ken_ml: Acknowledged — will request S3 link from PlayWell and start the eval as soon as artifacts land. Ping me with credentials.
sam_account: I’ll loop in finance for a temporary extension and confirm before EOD. :thumbsup:
sara_risk: Also recommend we add a regressions alert tied to our safety eval set (can set webhook to #incidents) so we spot any drift post-deploy.
maria_cs: Good point — add that to the checklist. I’ll capture feedback from the customer after enablement and add to our onboarding retro. Thanks team!
notes: customer onboarding, safety evals, renewal at-risk, enablement coordination
